featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 内容生产统一入口下，CSDN 和百家号清楚呈现技术文章流程，小红书独立版呈现图文笔记流程。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Under the shared Content Production entry, CSDN and Baijiahao use a technical article flow while the separate Xiaohongshu edition uses an image and text note flow.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 小红书明确区分笔记文字与配图：先保存文字，随后生成简介和配图；文字导出不再暗示已包含图片。
bugFixes.en-US: Clarify that Xiaohongshu note text is saved before summary and image creation, and that draft exports contain text only.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 业务入口统一为内容生产，依次完成生产准备、生成内容、检查修改和保存导出。小红书使用笔记称呼。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use Content Production as the workflow entry with preparation, generation, review and export. Refer to Xiaohongshu output as notes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 主工具在 Windows 安装时备份目标确实指向旧 SEO 程序的快捷方式，减少误开旧版；原有数据和配置保留。
bugFixes.en-US: When installing the main Windows app, archive verified shortcuts to the earlier SEO program while keeping its data and settings.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 恢复原名毕方内容生产助手，用写作准备、生成文章、检查修改、保存导出四步完成文章。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Restore the Bifang Content Production Assistant name and organize writing into preparation, generation, review and export.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 保留原批量写作、AI、飞书及统计模块；文章可继续简介、配图和飞书同步。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Keep the original batch writing, AI, Feishu and telemetry modules; continue saved articles through summaries, images and Feishu.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 首次写作明确引导接入自己的 AI Key，配置读取失败可重试，保存不自动调用服务。
bugFixes.en-US: Guide first-time writers to connect their own AI key, distinguish settings errors and avoid automatic service calls on save.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 切换页面保留当前输入，未保存的编辑不能导出，转入批量流程时避免覆盖已有正文。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep current input across pages, require saving before export and prevent overwriting divergent batch article content.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 整合关键词对标、风格库、二创写作与独立小红书工具，保留 SEO 版统计和版本发现服务。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Integrate benchmark research, style libraries, rewriting and the separate Xiaohongshu tool while preserving SEO telemetry and version discovery.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 小红书使用独立应用身份，独立公共服务登记前显示未配置。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use a separate Xiaohongshu application identity; public services remain unconfigured until independently registered.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 重复采集时保留已经读取的互动数据，未提供的指标继续显示为缺失。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve previously observed engagement metrics during recollection and keep unavailable values marked as missing.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 批量生成缺少 AI 服务、凭据或提示词时，明确显示出错阶段与配置原因。
bugFixes.en-US: Show the affected stage and configuration cause when batch generation lacks an AI service, credential or prompt.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加关键词对标采集、公开互动数据筛选及选定作品二创。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add keyword benchmark collection, public engagement filters and writing from selected works.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加多作者风格库、可编辑内置提示词和一键应用风格。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a multi-author style library, editable built-in prompts and one-click style application.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 提供独立的 SEO 文章与小红书笔记工具，沿用用户自行配置的 AI API。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Provide separate SEO article and Xiaohongshu note tools using user-configured AI APIs.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 首次启动默认中文，Windows 安装向导使用简体中文。
bugFixes.en-US: Use Chinese on first launch and Simplified Chinese in the Windows installer.
